reason: I already paid an agency $1,500 a month for a year and got click reports instead of jobs, so a free look from someone out of Roscoe is not going to win me over. The free hour is the hook, and I have been hooked before.
objection: How do I know the free write-up will not just be a sales pitch that ends with and that will be $3,500? I have heard tell you what I would fix before and it cost me a year and a lot of money.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from a business like mine, a truck or a one-chair shop, not a big company, that says plainly how many jobs they got out of it and what they paid, and that I can call that person myself.
